title: docs: regenerate APIDOCS.md
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Auto-generated from OpenAPI spec changes after a successful production deploy.

gist.headline: The API map gets redrawn
gist.blurb: The API docs get a fresh pass from the OpenAPI spec. Even maps of endpoints need tending.
gist.summary: Regenerated APIDOCS.md from the OpenAPI spec, updating 15 lines and removing 11 so the reference reflects the spec.
gist.impact: Developers get an API reference aligned with the OpenAPI spec, without having to compare the two by hand.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the OpenAPI spec as a glowing terminal feeding a paper API map, with Polli carefully tending it like a garden. Use code-plants and a prominent lime-green glow; avoid depicting specific endpoints because the changed lines are not provided.
